home.heroTitle: Not sure if it's true? Ask before you believe it.
home.heroLead: Sat-Yukt checks messages, forwards, and voice notes against trusted sources — and tells you plainly, in your own language, whether to trust them.

inputCard.label: Ask Sat-Yukt right now
inputCard.placeholder: Paste or type the message you want to check…
inputCard.photoHint: Choose a screenshot or photo of the message you want to check.
inputCard.photoExtractedHint: You can edit this before checking, if anything looks wrong.

howItWorks.title: Four steps, one honest answer
howItWorks.lead: No account, no jargon — just a plain answer with a reason behind it.

steps.title: Share the message
steps.desc: Speak it, type it, or upload a screenshot of the forward you received.

steps.title: We check the sources
steps.desc: Compared against government portals, verified fact-checkers, and past reports.

steps.title: Get a plain verdict
steps.desc: True, false, misleading, or honestly unverifiable — with a confidence score.

steps.title: Listen, or share it
steps.desc: Every result can be read aloud, and flagged to help your community too.

verdictDemo.title: A verdict you don't need to read to understand
verdictDemo.lead: Color, icon, and voice all say the same thing — so literacy is never the barrier.
verdictDemo.claim: "You forwarded: a message claiming a new government scheme gives ₹50,000 to every household that shares this link."
verdictDemo.explanation: This is a known scam pattern. No such scheme exists on any official government portal. Messages asking you to share a link to "claim money" are almost always fraudulent.

true.label: Verified true
true.desc: Confirmed by an official or trusted source

misleading.label: Misleading
misleading.desc: Partly true, but missing important context

unverifiable.label: Unverifiable
unverifiable.desc: Not enough evidence — we say so honestly, never a guess

trustCards.title: Designed so literacy is never a barrier

cards.title: Voice comes first
cards.desc: One large mic button, front and center — speaking is always the fastest way in.

cards.title: Every answer is read aloud
cards.desc: Results are never text-only — a tap on the speaker reads the verdict out loud.

cards.title: Language in its own script
cards.desc: Pick हिंदी or தமிழ், not "Hindi" in English — no reading a second language to choose the first.

whatsapp.heading: Message us on WhatsApp
whatsapp.desc: Forward any suspicious message directly. No app to download, no typing needed.
whatsapp.qrAlt: QR code to open WhatsApp chat with Sat-Yukt

call.heading: Call and speak your question
call.desc: No smartphone needed. Call, listen, and speak — we'll answer out loud.

footer.tagline: Truth that reaches everyone · सच जानें, सुरक्षित रहें

result.title: We found an answer
result.footnote: Sat-Yukt uses trusted public sources. If we cannot verify something, we will say so clearly.

descriptions.unverifiable: We don’t have enough evidence to be sure.

text.true: You can share this safely — it is confirmed correct.
text.misleading: Do not forward this message. Tell the person who sent it that it may confuse others.
text.false: Do not forward this message. Tell the person who sent it that it is false.
text.unverifiable: We could not confirm this. Avoid sharing it until a trusted source verifies it.
